physical.medium_raw: Knotted woollen pile on woollen warp and weft
physical.physical_description:
Bag face.

WARP: cream/light brown wool; Z2S; 17 threads per inch (70 per dm).

WEFT: brown wool; Z-spun, unplied; 2 shoots after each row of knots, one if a single thread and one is 2 parallel threads; 13 knots per inch (50 per dm).

PILE: wool; 7 colours: dark red, red, orange, green, dark blue, blue, white; asymmetrical knot open to the left and tied around 2 threads; 110 knots per sq. inch (1750 per sq. dm).

SIDE FINISH: 2 cords overcast with brown wool.

END FINISH: Lower: missing but evidence of plain weave with cream weft.  Upper: 2 cms plain weave with red weft, turned and stitched in place; webbing attached later.

DESIGN: Field: red ground with 3 bands of 3 guls of a stepped cross quartered either orange/white or orange/dark blue and outlined in dark blue with a hooked cross in the centre, either dark blue or green on a dark red hexagon.  There is a secondary motif of 2 and 2 half bands of 2 and 2 half motifs.  Small geometric motifs in the centre lie on a red diamond with a striped border and 8 projections.  The horizontal ones are hooked; the vertical ones are wide, decorated and hooked.

Main border: red ground with hooked rectangles containing a red X-motif along the top and bottom borders and with inward-facing pairs of horns between them.  Along the sides the rectangle extends into triangular-like upper and lower corners.

Inner border: red ground with small blocks of other colours alternating with white and yellow flowerheads on brown.

Outer borders: (1) red ground with green latched hooks from either side interspersed along the bottom with small white squares and blue and yellow diagonal blocks (2) red ground with diagonal blocks of dark blue, blue and green.

Outermost border: undecorated red along the sides, which becomes the ground for the upper and lower bands.

Upper band: six vertical lines each ending in a pair of horns and composed of blue or green blocks.  From each there descends 2 pairs of diagonal lines in the same colours.  In the area between the vertical lines there are groups of 6 stylised flowerheads in dark blue and green and above the horns are 2 narrow bands of diagonal blocks in red, green and dark blue and above them a single narrow band of dark blue.  There is a patch from another carpet in the top centre.

Lower band: 6 vertical stems, hooked at the top and decorated with 2 parallel lines of either dark blue or dark green blocks, each bearing 5 pairs of branches decorated with green or blue blocks.
